ministries.title: Advocacy Ministry
ministries.description: Promoting social justice and advocating for African communities in the United States.
ministries.mission: NAACUS Advocacy Ministry seeks to inform the NAACUS membership and community-at-large of issues of social justice and human dignity concerning our communities and people of African descent all over the world.

ministries.title: Women's Ministry
ministries.description: Empowering women through retreats, workshops, and fellowship activities.
ministries.mission: The mission of NAACUS Women's Ministry is to promote relevant pastoral care, spiritual growth, love, and evangelization focused on African Catholic families in the United States.
programs: Community Outreach Health and Finance Forum

ministries.title: Youth Ministry
ministries.description: Nurturing young Catholics through faith formation, activities, and leadership development.
ministries.mission: Creating a space for individuals age 13-18 of the Catholic faith who identify with the African diaspora to meet, grow together spiritually and socially.

ministries.title: Young Adults Ministry
ministries.description: Supporting young adults (ages 19-39) in their spiritual journey and community life.
ministries.mission: Creating a space for young men and women of faith who identify with the African diaspora to convene and grow together, spiritually and socially.
programs: Come as You Are Social Hour (Quarterly)

ministries.title: Men's Ministry
ministries.description: Building brotherhood and strengthening faith among African Catholic men.
ministries.mission: Creating a community of African Catholic men dedicated to strengthening their faith and serving their families and communities.

ministries.title: Ministry for People with Disabilities
ministries.description: Creating inclusive opportunities for full participation in church life.
ministries.mission: Ensuring full inclusion and participation of people with disabilities in the life and mission of NAACUS.

ministries.title: Outreach Ministry
ministries.description: Extending the love of Christ through service to our communities.
ministries.mission: Serving the spiritual and material needs of African Catholics and our broader communities.

ministries.title: Resource Ministry
ministries.description: Providing educational materials and resources for spiritual growth.
ministries.mission: Providing quality resources to support spiritual growth, education, and formation.

ministries.title: Finance Ministry
ministries.description: Stewardship and financial management for NAACUS.
ministries.mission: Promoting faithful stewardship and transparent financial management of NAACUS resources.

ministries.title: Liturgy Ministry
ministries.description: Enhancing worship experiences through meaningful liturgical celebrations rooted in our Catholic faith and African heritage.
ministries.mission: To foster vibrant and reverent liturgical celebrations that honor our Catholic faith while incorporating the rich cultural expressions of the African diaspora.

ministries.title: Media Ministry
ministries.description: Communicating the NAACUS story through digital content, social media, and multimedia production.
ministries.mission: To amplify the voice and witness of NAACUS through creative media, digital storytelling, and effective communications across all platforms.

ministries.title: Fundraising Ministry
ministries.description: Mobilizing resources to support the mission and programs of NAACUS.
ministries.mission: To generate the financial resources needed to sustain and grow the mission of NAACUS through creative fundraising initiatives and community generosity.
